title: Audit and close completed-or-merged tickets, close legacy-format ticket
objective: Post-merge scan: identify tickets whose work was already done by either branch (especially main's opencode-customisations/statistic merges) and close or archive them. Cross-reference every open draft ticket against actual code/compose/README state to surface stale entries. Additionally, migrate the legacy-format ticket-legacy-10-host-metrics-sidecar.md into the v1 JSON number system (merged into ticket-021).

subtickets.title: Audit ticket-006 (Document workflow & update checklists)
subtickets.objective: Working conventions from the branch are now in README.md under sections like 'Building Status', 'Architecture Diagram', 'What Exists Now', 'Testing'. Compare against ticket-006's original scope. If all objectives met: move status to resolved, then archived. Note: ticket-006 currently has an empty objective field — fill it from the MD file or migration notes before deciding.

subtickets.title: Audit ticket-011 (Board views/dashboards) vs metrics sidecar state
subtickets.objective: Main branch added metrics-sidecar and host-metrics-tui but NOT board/dashboard features. Confirm whether 'board' portion was implemented anywhere (check agent/ or README for mentions). If only sparkline/metrics parts were done, split ticket-021 off as its ticket and keep draft for remaining board/dashboard work.

subtickets.title: Close migrated tickets that have equivalent modern JSON counterparts
subtickets.objective: The following legacy-format MD files have been superseded by new-style JSON + architecture/DECISIONS.md: ticket-legacy-10 (metrics sidecar) → now covered by ticket-020, ticket-014. Superseded-ticket-005 → documented in DECISIONS C.6. Ensure each has a clear cross-reference link to its modern equivalent.

subtickets.title: Flag tickets with empty objective fields for completion
subtickets.objective: Scan all docs/tickets/*.json files for objective field that is empty string or null. These are migration artifacts from the MD→JSON migration pass. List them with suggested objectives if possible, and create a ticket to fill them (if more than 5): this becomes an improvement/cleanup priority.

subtickets.title: Final numbering audit: resolve any remaining gaps
subtickets.objective: Confirm the merged tree has a contiguous numbered sequence from 1 through max without orphaned gaps. ticket-005 is accounted for (superseded). Check if ticket-016 exists in final state (uses ~number on main). Fix or document.

notes: This is a meta-ticket: its output drives changes to other tickets rather than adding code/features. After the merge completes, this audit should be performed within 2 sessions so stale tracking doesn't accumulate.
